situations.title: 통증 척도 초기 사정
situations.tagline: Can you tell me how bad the pain is, from zero to ten?
situations.brief: 통증의 강도·부위·양상·악화 요인을 NRS로 처음 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: On a scale of zero to ten, how would you rate your pain right now?
Can you point to exactly where it hurts?
Is it a sharp, dull, or burning kind of pain?
goals: 환자가 느끼는 통증을 판단 없이 그대로 받아들인다

situations.title: 진통제 투여 전 설명
situations.tagline: This medicine will ease your pain in about ten minutes.
situations.brief: 투여할 진통제의 종류·기대 효과·발현 시점을 환자에게 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm going to give you something for the pain now.
It usually starts working in about ten to fifteen minutes.
Let me know if it makes you feel drowsy or dizzy.

situations.title: 비약물적 통증 완화
situations.tagline: Let's try ice and a better position first.
situations.brief: 냉·온찜질, 체위, 환경 조정 등 비약물적 통증 완화 방법을 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's put a cold pack on it to bring the swelling down.
Try keeping the leg raised on this pillow.
I can dim the lights if that helps you relax.

situations.title: 알레르기·과거 반응 확인
situations.tagline: Have you ever had a bad reaction to a pain medicine?
situations.brief: 마약성 진통제·NSAID에 대한 알레르기와 과거 반응 이력을 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Are you allergic to any medications that you know of?
Have you ever taken morphine or codeine before?
What kind of reaction did you have last time?

situations.title: 통증 재평가 시점 안내
situations.tagline: I'll come back in twenty minutes to check your pain again.
situations.brief: 진통제 투여 후 언제 다시 통증을 사정할지 환자에게 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll check back with you in about twenty minutes.
If the pain gets worse before then, press this call button.
We'll rate it again to see if the medicine helped.
goals: 투약 후 재사정 시점을 명확히 안내한다

situations.title: 오피오이드 요구 환자
situations.tagline: I need something stronger — nothing else works for me.
situations.brief: 강한 마약성 진통제를 요구하는 환자와 통증 조절·약물추구 사이 균형을 잡으세요.
keyPhrases: I hear that your pain is real, and I want to help.
Let me tell you what the doctor has ordered for you.
We can also try other ways to bring the pain down.
goals: 통증 호소를 존중하면서 처방 범위를 설명한다
요구를 비난 없이 다루며 대안을 제시한다

situations.title: 만성 통증+급성 악화
situations.tagline: My usual dose isn't touching this new pain.
situations.brief: 내성이 있는 만성 통증 환자의 급성 악화를 사정하고 용량 고려를 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: How is this pain different from your usual pain?
Tell me what medicines you already take at home.
Because of your tolerance, the doctor may adjust the dose.
goals: 만성 기저 통증과 급성 악화를 구분한다

situations.title: 절차적 진정 사전 설명
situations.tagline: Before we relocate the shoulder, let me explain the sedation.
situations.brief: 절차적 진정을 앞두고 NPO·모니터링·회복 과정을 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: When did you last eat or drink anything?
We'll keep you on monitors the whole time.
You'll feel sleepy, and we'll wake you gently afterward.

situations.title: 소아 절차 통증
situations.tagline: We'll keep your son comfortable during the stitches.
situations.brief: 열상 봉합 전 진정에 대해 아동의 부모에게 설명하고 동의·안심을 얻으세요.
keyPhrases: We'll give him a little medicine so he won't feel the stitches.
You can stay right by his side the whole time.
Do you have any questions before we begin?

situations.title: 통증 축소·과장 감별
situations.tagline: You say it's fine, but you look uncomfortable.
situations.brief: 문화·표현 차이를 고려해 실제 통증 정도를 감별하며 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: It's okay to tell me if it really hurts.
I notice you're guarding that side — can you show me?
There's no need to tough it out with me.
goals: 언어·문화적 표현 차이를 고려해 통증을 판단한다

situations.title: 진통제 거부 환자
situations.tagline: I don't want any of those pain drugs.
situations.brief: 진통제를 거부하는 환자의 이유를 탐색하고 대안을 함께 찾으세요.
keyPhrases: Can you tell me what worries you about the medicine?
I respect your choice — let's talk about other options.
We can start with something milder if you prefer.

situations.title: 다중 약물 병용 통증
situations.tagline: Let's go over everything you take at home.
situations.brief: 여러 약물을 복용 중인 환자의 진정·상호작용 위험을 확인하며 통증을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: Can you list the medicines you took today?
Some of these can make you very sleepy together.
We'll choose something safe with what you already take.
goals: 복용 중인 약물과 진정 위험을 파악한다

situations.title: 언어장벽 통증 사정
situations.tagline: Point to the face that shows how you feel.
situations.brief: 언어 장벽이 있는 환자에게 얼굴 척도와 통역을 활용해 통증을 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: Let me get an interpreter so we understand each other.
Point to the face that matches your pain.
Show me with your hand where it hurts.
goals: 얼굴 척도와 통역으로 통증을 정확히 사정한다

situations.title: 회복 마취 후 관찰
situations.tagline: You're waking up now — take a slow, deep breath.
situations.brief: 진정에서 회복 중인 환자의 호흡·의식 회복을 관찰하며 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: Can you tell me your name and where you are?
Take a nice deep breath for me.
You did great — the procedure is all done.
goals: 의식 수준과 호흡 회복을 단계적으로 확인한다

situations.title: 절차적 진정 중 호흡억제
situations.tagline: Open your eyes for me — take a big breath.
situations.brief: 진정 중 호흡억제·저산소가 발생한 환자의 기도를 관리하며 자극·소통하세요.
keyPhrases: I need you to breathe deeply for me right now.
Open your eyes — squeeze my hand.
We're giving you extra oxygen to help you breathe.

situations.title: 오피오이드 과다·날록손
situations.tagline: You're safe — we gave you medicine to reverse it.
situations.brief: 오피오이드 과다복용을 날록손으로 역전한 뒤 각성한 환자와 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: You stopped breathing well, so we gave you a reversal medicine.
Do you know what you took today?
You may feel sick or shaky — that will pass.

situations.title: 난치성 급성 통증
situations.tagline: I know nothing has worked yet — we're not giving up.
situations.brief: 여러 약제에도 조절되지 않는 극심한 급성 통증 환자를 지지하며 재계획을 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: I can see this pain is unbearable, and I believe you.
We're calling the doctor to try a different approach.
Stay with me — we'll get on top of this together.
goals: 조절 실패를 인정하고 새 계획을 설명한다

situations.title: 진정 중 아나필락시스
situations.tagline: You're having a reaction — we're treating it right now.
situations.brief: 진정제에 대한 아나필락시스가 발생한 환자를 안심시키며 응급 대응을 알리세요.
keyPhrases: You're having an allergic reaction to the medicine.
We're giving you epinephrine to help you breathe.
Try to stay calm — we're right here with you.
goals: 아나필락시스를 즉시 인지하고 응급 처치를 알린다

situations.title: 말기 환자 통증 완화
situations.tagline: Our goal now is to keep her comfortable and at peace.
situations.brief: 말기 환자의 완화 진정에 대해 가족과 목표를 확인하며 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: Our focus now is her comfort, not more tests.
This medicine will ease her pain and let her rest.
Let's talk about what matters most to your family.

situations.title: 진정 후 급속 각성 흥분
situations.tagline: You're in the hospital and you're safe — you're okay.
situations.brief: 진정 회복기에 섬망으로 흥분한 환자를 안전하게 진정시키고 지남력을 도우세요.
keyPhrases: You're in the emergency room — you're safe here.
Let's keep your hands still so you don't hurt yourself.
I'm your nurse, and I'm staying right here.

situations.title: 중증 외상 통증 위기
situations.tagline: We'll ease the pain without dropping your pressure.
situations.brief: 혈역학이 불안정한 중증 외상 환자에게 통증·진정을 신중히 조절하며 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: We're giving you something for the pain, in small amounts.
Stay with me and keep looking at my eyes.
We're watching your blood pressure very closely.
goals: 극심한 통증 속 환자와 접촉을 유지한다
